crossRefs.note: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people…
because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy…
because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of…

people.name: Ezion-geber
people.line: Israelite encampment; port city on Red Sea

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

people.name: Zin
people.line: A desert and wilderness region south of Judah

translations.web: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
translations.bsb: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin (the same is Kadesh).
